# unity-cli-bridge

> Command-line interface for the Unity Editor for scripts and AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build). Declarative commands return JSON over a local pipe or socket. No MCP server and no Python server. Unity 2021.3 LTS or later. Published CLI builds: macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/yhc509/unity-cli-bridge/blob/main/README.md): install, requirements, comparison, FAQ, commands, limits
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/yhc509/unity-cli-bridge/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md): generated command list
- [Scene spec](https://github.com/yhc509/unity-cli-bridge/blob/main/docs/scene-spec.md): scene patch paths and operations
- [Prefab spec](https://github.com/yhc509/unity-cli-bridge/blob/main/docs/prefab-spec.md): prefab inspect and patch
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/yhc509/unity-cli-bridge/tree/main/plugins/unity-cli-bridge/skills/unity-cli-bridge): skill installed by the Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build plugin
- [Changelog](https://github.com/yhc509/unity-cli-bridge/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Install

- Unity package: `https://github.com/yhc509/unity-cli-bridge.git?path=/unity-package/com.yhc509.unity-cli-bridge#main`
- CLI: Window > Unity CLI Manager, or the archives on the GitHub Releases page
- Skill: plugin install is the recommended path (see the README). A file copy for Codex goes under `.agents/skills/unity-cli-bridge/`
